mentions.name: Principal AI Engineer
mentions.description: A harness that learns your codebase, proactively asks the questions you didn't think of, and shows you exactly what to fix so AI-built projects stop breaking in production. It packages a principal engineer's review process into an AI agent.
mentions.problem: AI-assisted projects break in production because important questions and issues go unasked and unfixed.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on a Principal AI Engineer - a harness that learns your code, asks the questions you didn’t think of, shows you exactly what to fix, so your AI project stops breaking in production. Basically, turning what I do for a living into an agent.
mentions.author: kuchin
